results.question: How far in advance must vacation requests be submitted?
results.answer: [1] Vacation requests must be submitted at least 14 calendar days before the first day of leave.

results.question: How many days per week may staff work remotely?
results.answer: [1] Harborview | Synthetic Demo Knowledge harborview_employee_handbook.pdf page 2: Employees may work remotely up to three days each week with manager approval.

results.question: When must employees report a lost laptop?
results.answer: [1] Lost equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours.
